title: Interactive VPC Setup Checklist + Installer Overlay Screens
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and produce a set of onboarding visuals and UI overlays that guide customers through Private/VPC installation and upgrades. Deliver an interactive checklist flow that surfaces preflight checks, networking topology hints, copy-to-clipboard installer snippets, progressive upgrade UI states (canary, staged rollout, rollback), and contextual troubleshooting cards. The visuals must be usable in the Console quickstart, the docs site, and an emailed onboarding digest.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive checklist mockups (desktop + tablet) that include network preflight failures and inline remediation tips
Installer overlay screens for three install modalities: CLI token install, Terraform module, and air-gapped installer avatar
Upgrade modal states: confirm, canary rollout progress, staged percentage slider, rollback confirmation and success/failure states
Accessible versions (high-contrast + keyboard navigation) for all interactive components
Figma file with component variants, exports for PNG/SVG assets, and a short handoff README describing interactions and microcopy
Links to Confluence PRD, a Github PR template for frontend work, and QA test cases
tasks: Kickoff: align with PM and Eng on required preflight checks and telemetry events
Create low-fidelity flow: interactive checklist states (not-started, in-progress, blocked, completed)
Design installer overlay patterns: terminal snippet, copy CTA, inline validation errors
Design upgrade modal and rollback path with clear customer messaging
Produce hi-fi Figma frames and export 1x/2x PNG + SVG assets
Write handoff README including interaction specs, focus order, and aria roles
Collect engineering feedback and iterate (2 rounds)
Deliver final assets to design-system and link PR for Console implementation
Coordinate accessibility review and security review signoff
mockups: Checklist - network blocked state with suggested CIDR fixes
Installer overlay - CLI token flow with copy CTA and success toast
Installer overlay - Terraform module with inline variable mapping helper
Installer overlay - air-gapped instructions with transfer checklist
Upgrade modal - canary rollout with progress graph
Upgrade modal - staged percentage slider + expected downtime note
Rollback modal - confirm + automated rollback timeline
Troubleshooting card - common NAT/route issues + remediation links
Accessibility variants - high contrast and keyboard flow
notes: Prefer progressive disclosure: only surface advanced networking details if preflight flags them as relevant
Installer snippets should be pre-filled with region and project placeholders; CTA to copy should persist state so users can retry after fix
Upgrade UX needs to surface cost/regression risk and include an opt-in canary default for Dedicated customers
Work with Eng to map telemetry events for 'checklist_step_failed' and 'upgrade_rollout_started'
Prepare small A/B test: checklist inline remediation vs. link to docs to measure completion rate
